weekly_theme.summary: 這段期間沒有特別重大的星象事件，是適合按自己步調安排生活的一週。

aries.horoscope: 今天，牡羊座，你內心的火焰正在熊熊燃燒，必須小心處理這種能量。擁抱你的驕傲和自信；昂首挺胸，向前邁步。雖然你的自由感至關重要，但請注意，其他人可能會誤以為你對真正重要的人或事物漠不關心。讓你的心以真誠和開放的方式表達自己。
aries.horoscope_en: Today, Aries, your inner fire is blazing brightly, and it's essential to handle this energy with care. Embrace your pride and confidence; stride forward with your head held high and shoulders back. While your sense of freedom is vital, be mindful that others may misread it as indifference towards someone or something that truly matters to you. Allow your heart to express itself with sincerity and openness.

taurus.horoscope: 金牛座，你可能會發現別人把你認為微不足道的事情小題大作。花點時間欣賞周圍環境的美麗和意義。記得承認自己的價值和你帶來的獨特特質。您的自我意識可能會轉變，影響您與周圍世界的互動方式。
taurus.horoscope_en: Taurus, you might find that others are making a big deal out of something you consider trivial. Take a moment to appreciate the beauty and significance in your surroundings. Remember to acknowledge your own worth and the unique qualities you bring to the table. Your sense of self may undergo a shift, influencing how you engage with the world around you.

gemini.horoscope: 雙子座，今天對你來說是一個關鍵時刻，你可能會遇到周圍人們對你的選擇的一些阻力。請記住，當情況需要時優先考慮自己的需求是完全可以接受的。花點時間反思自己的成就並擁抱自己。避免融入人群的誘惑，或相信你的快樂和成就取決於別人的成就。
gemini.horoscope_en: Today marks a pivotal moment for you, Gemini, and you might encounter some pushback from those around you regarding your choices. Remember, it's perfectly acceptable to prioritize your own needs when the circumstances call for it. Take a moment to reflect on your own achievements and embrace the person you are. Avoid the temptation to blend into the crowd or believe that your joy and accomplishments hinge on the achievements of others.

cancer.horoscope: 今天，巨蟹座，不要猶豫，更大膽地表達自己。您會發現，與周圍的人公開、誠實地分享您的想法可以帶來更順利的結果。掌控自己的內在力量，而不是讓別人操縱你。你的真實本性很容易被動搖，所以要保持警惕，確保你不會處於不利地位。
cancer.horoscope_en: Today, Cancer, don’t hesitate to express yourself more boldly. You’ll discover that sharing your thoughts openly and honestly with those around you can lead to smoother outcomes. Take charge of your inner strength rather than allowing others to pull your strings. Your genuine nature can be swayed easily, so stay vigilant to ensure you’re not left at a disadvantage.

leo.horoscope: 今天，獅子座，邀請你盡情享受自己的才華。你擁有觸手可及的非凡能量和力量。你的信心堅定、充滿活力，並準備好迎接任何挑戰。以溫暖和積極的態度擁抱周圍充滿活力的能量。火熱的氣氛將支持您對快樂的追求。請記住，您值得追求卓越，所以要志存高遠！
leo.horoscope_en: Today, Leo, you are invited to revel in your own brilliance. You possess a remarkable amount of energy and strength at your fingertips. Your confidence is robust, invigorated, and prepared to take on any challenge. Embrace the vibrant energies around you with warmth and positivity. The fiery atmosphere will support your quest for joy. Remember, you deserve nothing short of excellence, so aim high!

virgo.horoscope: 處女座，讓你的一天變得更明亮。這可能是喚醒你內心之火並用你一直壓抑的勇氣表達它的完美時刻。透過與周圍的人分享真實的自我來優先考慮你的治療。避免僅為了滿足別人而配合的誘惑。請記住，忠於自己是最重要的。
virgo.horoscope_en: Infuse your day with a bit more brightness, Virgo. It could be the perfect moment to awaken your inner fire and express it with the boldness you’ve been holding back. Prioritize your healing by sharing your authentic self with those around you. Avoid the temptation to play along just to satisfy others. Remember, staying true to who you are is the most important thing.

libra.horoscope: 天秤座，你內心的火焰能夠輕鬆地將潛力轉化為行動。請記住，您的話語具有重要意義；他們可以以你可能無法完全掌握的方式影響你周圍的人。重要的是要承認它們可能產生的影響並謹慎使用它們。盡量減少表達自己的頻率，但當你這樣做時，讓每個短語都產生雙倍的影響。
libra.horoscope_en: Libra, your inner fire has the ability to transform potential into action with ease. Remember, your words hold significant weight; they can influence those around you in ways you might not fully grasp. It's important to acknowledge the effects they can have and to wield them with care. Aim to express yourself less frequently, but when you do, let each phrase carry double the impact.

scorpio.horoscope: 今天，天蠍座，盡量不要陷入不斷變化的情緒。相反，要著眼於大局，認識對你有利的正面力量。保持樂觀的態度，提醒自己在這個世界上有一個目標。透過與自己和周圍環境保持聯繫來忠於自己的價值觀。擁抱在安靜時刻發現的力量，珍惜它們帶來的平靜。
scorpio.horoscope_en: Today, Scorpio, try not to get caught up in your changing emotions. Instead, focus on the bigger picture and recognize the positive forces aligning in your favor. Keep a hopeful outlook and remind yourself that you have a purpose in this world. Stay true to your values by remaining connected to yourself and your surroundings. Embrace the strength found in quiet moments, and treasure the peace they bring.

sagittarius.horoscope: 今天是你光芒四射的時刻，射手座！毫無保留地擁抱完整的自己。你會發現你內心有豐富的愛，準備表達出來。當你表現出你的愛、熱情和溫暖時，你的情緒可能會達到新的高度。只需確保您選擇與之分享的人認可並回報這種真正的能量。
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Today is your moment to radiate, Sagittarius! Embrace your full self without reservation. You'll discover an abundance of love within you, ready to be expressed. Your emotions may reach new heights as you demonstrate your love, enthusiasm, and warmth. Just ensure that this genuine energy is recognized and returned by those you choose to share it with.

capricorn.horoscope: 摩羯座，今天請專注於自己的抱負和願望。氣氛中充滿了強大且潛在的操縱能量，如果你不保持警惕，可能會讓你誤入歧途。相信自己的能力並堅持自己的立場，尤其是在緊張局勢加劇的情況下。請記住，重要的是要引導自己的道路，而不是簡單地讓它滾下坡路。
capricorn.horoscope_en: Capricorn, keep your focus on your own ambitions and aspirations today. The atmosphere is charged with potent and potentially manipulative energies that could lead you astray if you're not vigilant. Trust in your abilities and stand your ground, especially if tensions rise. Remember, it's essential to steer your own path rather than simply letting it roll downhill.

aquarius.horoscope: 水瓶座，今天花點時間走出去，伸向天堂，恢復活力。擁抱你內在的力量和勇氣。你有能力將充滿挑戰的環境轉變為令人振奮的事情，但這首先要擺脫任何揮之不去的自我懷疑。請記住，如果您對自己的能力缺乏信心，別人就很難相信您。向世界清楚傳達您的立場。
aquarius.horoscope_en: Take a moment today to rejuvenate by stepping outside and reaching for the heavens, Aquarius. Embrace your inner strength and bravery. You possess the ability to transform a challenging circumstance into something uplifting, but it starts with shedding any lingering self-doubt. Remember, if you lack faith in your own abilities, it will be difficult for others to believe in you. Clearly communicate your position to the world.

pisces.horoscope: 今天，雙魚座，如果你試圖在沒有純粹意圖的情況下將自己的意志強加於他人，你可能會遇到具有挑戰性的情況。請注意，您可能會利用別人的恐懼來獲得控制權，這可能會導致不健康的動態。與其猛烈抨擊，不如專注於建立聯繫而不是衝突。透過培養聯盟，你會發現真的沒有什麼好害怕的。
pisces.horoscope_en: Today, Pisces, you may encounter challenging situations if you attempt to impose your will on others without pure intentions. Be mindful that you might be leveraging someone else's fear to gain control, which can lead to unhealthy dynamics. Instead of lashing out, focus on building connections rather than conflicts. By fostering alliances, you'll discover that there's truly nothing to fear.
